# Shop Lamees

Shop Lamees is an abaya-focused ecommerce store with Arabic and English storefront content.

## Storefront scope
- Home: `/`
- Latest products: `/latest`
- Category listing: `/category/{slug}`
- Product detail: `/product/{slug}`
- Search: `/search`
- Cart: `/cart`
- Checkout: `/checkout`

## Legal and policy pages
- Privacy Policy: `/privacy-policy`
- Terms: `/terms`
- Return Policy: `/return-policy`

## Product and pricing notes
- Product pages include size/cut options and made-to-order context where applicable.
- Displayed prices are localized by currency preference where supported by the UI.

## Language support
- Arabic (`ar`)
- English (`en`)

No other public language variants are currently in scope.
